title: MasterPostProcessor AGI Enhancement — Cost-Efficient G-Code
brief: Enhance existing MasterPostProcessorAGIOrchestrationEngine. Full machine exploitation (canned cycles, sub-programs, macros), controller-specific optimization (Fanuc/Okuma/Haas/Heidenhain), G-code compression (redundant-move removal, arc-fitting), cycle time optimization. Output: smallest, fastest, safest G-code for each machine.

must_include: Machine dynamic model (jerk, accel, velocity limits)

units.title: ControllerCannedCycleExploiterEngine — replace long ops with canned cycles
units.intent: Detect sequences that should use canned cycles (G81-G89 drilling, G71/G72 lathe roughing, G70 finishing). Replace verbose equivalents with canned cycle — shorter, faster, safer.

loops.loop_1_build: Pattern matcher (detect hole array → G81, lathe rough loop → G71). Parameter extractor. Controller-specific syntax gen.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Post-processor expert + machinist reviewer. Check: peck depth, retract, dwell semantics per controller.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: G73 high-speed peck, G74/G84 tapping, G76 fine boring, G82 dwell drill.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: G-code size reduction 40%+ on drilling-heavy programs. No behavior change vs verbose form.

units.title: ArcFittingOptimizerEngine — replace linear-interp circles with G2/G3
units.intent: CAM systems often output thousands of tiny G1 moves for circular/spline segments. Fit G2/G3 arcs (or G06.2 NURBS) where accurate. Reduce program size 70%+ on complex 2D profiles.

loops.loop_1_build: Biarc fitter with tolerance. Chord-to-arc error check. G2/G3 emitter (I/J/K absolute or R-form).
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Numerical analysis PhD + CAM expert. Check: tolerance honoring, arc direction correctness.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Program size -70% on 10 profile-heavy parts, 0 dimensional deviation beyond tolerance.

units.title: ControllerDialectTranslatorEngine — Fanuc/Okuma/Haas/Heidenhain
units.intent: Convert canonical G-code to controller-specific dialect. Macro variable conventions, decimal point handling, modal G-code behavior, work offsets (G54-G59.x or G15 H-).

loops.loop_1_build: Dialect table (modal states, decimal handling, block numbering). Per-controller emitter.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Multi-controller expert. Check: each dialect against real machine behavior.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Dialect translation passes syntax check on 4 controller emulators; dry-run validates on real Haas/Okuma/Fanuc/Heidenhain.
exit_gate.abort_criteria: If syntax errors on any dialect.

units.title: RedundantMoveEliminatorEngine — remove dead code
units.intent: Detect and remove redundant moves: zero-length (same point), colinear sequences (collapse), repeated spindle/coolant/modal commands.

loops.loop_1_build: Move scanner. Colinear collapse. Modal state tracker (don't re-emit G0/G1 when modal).
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: CNC specialist. Check: safety implications of collapse (no removal of essential dwells).

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 5-15% size reduction on JM Die programs, 0 tool path behavior change.

units.title: CycleTimeMinimizerEngine — motion optimization via machine dynamics (SAFETY-GATED)
units.intent: Model machine kinematics (jerk/accel/velocity envelope). Optimize rapids: diagonal vs Cartesian, Z-first vs XY-first. Reorder operations for minimum positioning time. Every reorder commit must pass prism_safety.check_toolpath_collision AND S(x) >= 0.70 AND Z-safety-plane preservation. Hard-fails on any violation.

safety_requirements.collision_check: Before every rapid reorder commit, call prism_safety dispatcher action 'check_toolpath_collision' with proposed trajectory. Any collision → reject reorder, keep original ordering.
safety_requirements.sx_gate: SafetyEngine.evaluate() on full optimized program must return S(x) >= 0.70. Below threshold → HARD BLOCK, return original program unchanged.
safety_requirements.z_safety_plane: Optimized rapids MUST retain Z retract to machine-specific safety plane before XY traversal. Violation = hard-fail, not a warning.
safety_requirements.deterministic_rollback: On ANY safety check failure, engine emits OptimizationRejected with reason and returns original program byte-for-byte identical.

loops.loop_1_build: Per-axis dynamic profile (accel/jerk/vmax). Rapid reorder (TSP-style heuristic). Z-safety-plane guard enforced before commit. prism_safety.check_toolpath_collision call integrated as mandatory step in commit path. SafetyEngine S(x) gate wired in. Fail-closed semantics: ANY failure yields original program.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Optimization PhD + machinist + safety lead. Check: collision safety during optimized rapids, Z-safety-plane enforcement under all tool/geometry combos, S(x) gate reached for every commit, deterministic rollback on rejection.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Operation-level reorder (drill-all-holes-first vs stay-in-tool-group), with same safety envelope.
loops.loop_4_tie_up: JSDoc. Safety invariants documented. Review sign-off by safety-physics agent.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 10-20% cycle time reduction measured on 10 JM Die programs. 0 Z-safety-plane violations on regression corpus. 100% of reorder commits gated through prism_safety.check_toolpath_collision + S(x) >= 0.70.
exit_gate.abort_criteria: If crash/collision in simulation; if ANY Z-safety violation accepted; if S(x) < 0.70 commit ever observed.

units.title: SubProgramMacroLibraryEngine — reusable macro library
units.intent: Detect repeated G-code blocks → extract as sub-programs (M98/M99) or macros. Build shop-wide macro library usable across programs. Shrinks library size, increases consistency.

loops.loop_1_build: Block-similarity detector. Macro parameterization. M98/M99 emitter. Macro B (Fanuc) / user macro (Okuma) synthesis.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: G-code veteran machinist. Check: macro safety (parameter validation, bounds).
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Macro versioning, shop governance (who can edit).

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 20 macros extracted from JM Die library, 100% behavior match.
